---
title: "Implement leaf_id leakage guard for train/val/test splits"
labels: ["task", "research"]
---

## Summary

Implement and enforce a `leaf_id`-based splitting strategy to prevent data leakage. The PlantVillage dataset contains multiple images per physical leaf. Splitting at the image level without grouping by leaf identity causes the same physical leaf to appear in both the training and test sets, leading to artificially inflated performance metrics.

## Why It Matters

This is the most critical data integrity constraint in the entire project. Any performance metric computed without this guard is invalid and misleading. Published benchmarks that ignore this constraint cannot be trusted or compared to properly evaluated results.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] A `leaf_id` field (or equivalent identifier) is extracted or inferred from the dataset file structure
- [x] All train/val/test splits are generated by grouping images at the `leaf_id` level before partitioning
- [x] A leakage audit function is implemented and can confirm no `leaf_id` appears in more than one partition
- [x] Split manifests committed to `data/splits/` contain `leaf_id` grouping information
- [x] `data/splits/README.md` documents the split policy and leakage prevention approach
- [x] The leakage audit is run and passes before any model is trained or evaluated

## Dependencies

- Issue #01: Dataset ingestion must be complete before splits can be generated

## Notes

- PlantVillage filenames often encode leaf or image metadata — inspect naming conventions carefully
- If `leaf_id` cannot be extracted directly, document the approach used to approximate leaf-level grouping
- This constraint must also be mentioned in the model card (`MODEL_CARD.md`) and README
- See `DATASET_NOTES.md` for the full description of this risk

---

## Status

Done. Leaf ids rebuilt in `src/data/grouping.py` (author leaf map + camera file name + in-name leaf numbers + file hashes); images without an id are split by contiguous camera segments with a 20-frame purge buffer. `src/data/splits.py:audit_splits` checks group, leaf id, camera frame and md5 overlap plus the frame buffer; the audit is re-run in CI by `scripts/audit_manifest.py` and blocks test-set evaluation. Policy and numbers: `data/splits/README.md`.
